next.reason: 1985 requires the same access mode and a RELATIVE KEY naming the same external data item in every entry for an external file connector (§1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8). §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1 keeps 'f) The same access mode' and 'h) The same specification of the RELATIVE KEY clause, where data-name-7 references an external data item', and §2023:14.8.4.2 removes any doubt that h) is a requirement: 'the file status, linage and relative key data items shall be external data items and shall refer to the same corresponding storage'. A violation, undefined in 1985, may now raise EC-EXTERNAL-DATA-MISMATCH when checking is enabled; a conforming 1985 program is unaffected. 14.8.4.2 has no catalog rule id, so 'to' names GR1 only.
